design_detail: Enforce existing 1944 net wealth tax on bank assets over $1B
quote_original: Het is onvoorstelbaar dat Surinamers ruim een miljard dollar bij de banken hebben liggen. De regering haalt daartegenover gemiddeld niet eens vijf miljoen Surinaamse dollar (ongeveer een half miljoen euro) aan vermogensbelasting binnenhaalt
quote_en: It is unimaginable that Surinamers have over a billion dollars in banks, yet the government collects on average not even five million Surinamese dollars in wealth tax
source_title: Regering moet meer belasting halen bij Surinamers
grading_note: Plenary speech in De Nationale Assemblée demanding aggressive collection of wealth tax from wealthy individuals with large bank deposits

design_detail: Wealth tax rather than VAT and wage tax
quote_original: waarom de regering weigert de vermogensbelasting in te voeren. Het is volgens de parlementariër een schande dat het fiscaal beleid steeds de focus legt op consumptie- (btw) en loonbelasting, in plaats van de vermogenden aan te pakken.
quote_en: why the government refuses to introduce the wealth tax. According to the parliamentarian it is a shame that fiscal policy focuses on consumption (VAT) and wage taxes instead of tackling the wealthy.
source_title: Minister Raghoebarsing stelt invoering vermogensbelasting ter discussie
grading_note: Plenary parliamentary speech in DNA demanding the government implement wealth taxation on the rich rather than regressive consumption taxes

design_detail: Tighten 1944 wealth tax simultaneously with mandatory asset declaration (VIV)
quote_original: De Wet Vermogensbelasting simultaan aanpassen met de aanscherping van de regels rond de Verklaring van Inkomen en Vermogen (VIV), die alle publieke functionarissen verplicht stelt hun vermogen op te geven.
quote_en: Simultaneously adapt the Wealth Tax Act with the tightening of rules around the Declaration of Income and Assets (VIV), which obliges all public officials to declare their assets.
source_title: Asabina: ‘Verplicht vermogen opgeven en vermogensbelasting gaan hand in hand’
grading_note: Specific policy proposal to amend the Wet Vermogensbelasting and close foundation loopholes alongside asset transparency

design_detail: Expand 1944 wealth tax to legal entities (foundations and holdings) to raise 500M SRD annually
quote_original: Ravaksur heeft herhaaldelijk gepleit om de wet vermogensbelasting te wijzigen, zodat de overheid effectiever vermogensbelasting kan gaan innen. Het lijkt erop dat er geen vermogenden zijn in Suriname, omdat de overheid nauwelijks inkomsten aan vermogensbelasting binnen krijgt.
quote_en: Ravaksur has repeatedly advocated amending the wealth tax law so that the government can collect wealth tax more effectively. It seems as if there are no wealthy people in Suriname, because the government hardly receives any wealth tax revenue.
source_title: Ravaksur-woordvoerder Zunder: “Nieuwe regering moet zich meer richten op middelen generering bij financieel beleid”
grading_note: Statement by union spokesperson and economist proposing statutory reform of the wealth tax to include corporate foundations and holding companies

design_detail: Raise wealth tax exemption threshold from SRD 100,000 to SRD 1,600,000 to target real wealth
quote_original: Onderdeel van het wensenpakket van Ravaksur plus bij de loononderhandelingen met de overheid is de aanpassing van de belastingvrije som in de wet vermogensbelasting.
quote_en: Part of the list of demands of Ravaksur plus in wage negotiations with the government is the adjustment of the tax-free sum in the wealth tax act.
source_title: Ravaksur wil aanpassing belastingvrije som vermogensbelasting
grading_note: Formal collective bargaining claim by union confederation Ravaksur proposing updating the wealth tax exemption threshold to SRD 1.6M

design_detail: Party platform on wealth taxation for wealth redistribution
quote_original: Tegelijkertijd pleit de BEP voor meer focus op belasting op consumptie (zoals btw) en vermogensbelasting.
quote_en: At the same time, the BEP advocates more focus on consumption tax (such as VAT) and wealth tax.
source_title: Ronny Asabina (BEP): “Suriname heeft behoefte aan een radicale koerswijziging”
grading_note: Party policy platform presented by BEP party leadership demanding wealth taxation for wealth redistribution

design_detail: Party call for a thorough wealth tax to tackle inequality
quote_original: Het gebrek aan evenwichtige maatregelen van de regering, zoals een gedegen vermogensbelasting en effectieve belastinginning binnen de kleinschalige goudsector
quote_en: The lack of balanced measures from the government, such as a thorough wealth tax and effective tax collection within the small-scale gold sector
source_title: PRO: Wrokoman Dei door asociaal regeringsbeleid ‘Brokoman Dei’
grading_note: Official party Labour Day declaration by Partij voor Recht en Ontwikkeling demanding a thorough wealth tax

design_detail: Enforce 0.8% wealth tax above SRD 200,000 threshold
quote_original: De overheid put te weinig uit de financiële mogelijkheden van de vermogensbelasting. Er wordt nauwelijks vermogensbelasting gevorderd bij de burger.
quote_en: The government draws too little on the financial possibilities of the wealth tax. Barely any wealth tax is claimed from citizens.
source_title: Surinaamse overheid zoekt extra belastinggeld op de verkeerde plekken
grading_note: Public interview by tax consultant advocating active enforcement of the existing statutory wealth tax of under 1% on fortunes above SRD 200,000

design_detail: Enforce 0.8% net wealth tax and tax real estate foundations
quote_original: De consequentie hiervan is dat de opbrengst van de vermogensbelasting beperkt zal blijven als de onroerendgoedstichtingen niet onder de werking van de VB worden gebracht.
quote_en: The consequence of this is that the revenue of the wealth tax will remain limited if real estate foundations are not brought under the scope of the VB.
grading_note: Op-ed by jurist and former notary in Dagblad Suriname arguing the state forfeits major revenue by neglecting enforcement of the net wealth tax

design_detail: Enforce statutory wealth tax on 8000 wealthy families and companies rather than collecting a token SRD 8 million
quote_original: Een ander heel opmerkelijk bedrag aan de inkomstenzijde is dat van de vermogensbelasting. Daar wordt een beschamend bedrag van SRD 8 miljoen SRD per jaar genoemd.
quote_en: Another very remarkable figure on the revenue side is that of the wealth tax. There a shameful amount of SRD 8 million per year is mentioned.
grading_note: Plenary speech in De Nationale Assemblée during the 2023 budget debate criticizing the government for budgeting a paltry SRD 8M in wealth tax while leaving thousands of wealthy families and firms untaxed

design_detail: Enforce wealth tax and address poor tax administration to remove barrier to economic growth
quote_original: functioneert het belastingkantoor slecht en wordt er nauwelijks vermogensbelasting betaald.
quote_en: the tax office functions poorly and virtually no wealth tax is paid.
source_title: Verslag van een werkbezoek aan Suriname en Brazilië (Kamerstuk 36 572 nr. 1)
grading_note: Official parliamentary record of formal consultations in Paramaribo where VES chairman noted weak tax administration and failure to collect wealth taxes as a fundamental brake on economic growth Review correction: an observation that the wealth tax is barely collected, quoted in an official record; support for enforcing it is implied, so B.

design_detail: Professional economic association position identifying failure to collect wealth taxes as a barrier to economic growth
quote_original: functioneert het belastingkantoor slecht en wordt er nauwelijks vermogensbelasting betaald.
quote_en: the tax office functions poorly and virtually no wealth tax is paid.
source_title: Verslag van een werkbezoek aan Suriname en Brazilië (Kamerstuk 36 572 nr. 1)
grading_note: Official record of formal consultations by VES leadership with parliamentary delegation representing the association's policy advice Review correction: the same quote as E00011, attributed to the association; B.

design_detail: Enforce existing statutory wealth tax as part of post-crisis domestic revenue mobilisation
quote_original: Achaibersing zegt dat er al een wet op vermogensbelasting bestaat. Alleen zal de uitvoering hiervan beter moeten plaatsvinden.
quote_en: Achaibersing says that an act on wealth tax already exists. Only the implementation thereof will have to take place better.
source_title: Aanpassing belastingschijven en heffingskorting voor lagere inkomensgroepen
grading_note: Official ministerial policy statement upon taking office as Minister of Finance and Planning declaring that active enforcement of the statutory wealth tax is part of the government's domestic revenue mobilization package Review correction: the quote is the journalist's narration of the minister's statement, so B.
